package.description: Combine several files into one, byte for byte, without converting character encodings.

en-US.description: Combine several files into one, byte for byte, without converting character encodings.
en-US.longDescription:
TekuTeku File Merge combines several files into one, byte for byte, in the order you choose.
Nothing is decoded, re-encoded or converted, so CSV files, logs, text in any character encoding
and split binary files (.001, .002, ...) come out unchanged. Add files and folders by drag and
drop, reorder them or sort by name, date, size or path. Optional: add CRLF to files that do not
end with a line break, and remove the BOM from files after the first. 21 languages, light and
dark themes, no network access.
en-US.name: TekuTeku File Merge
